text:
Maya (mktg): thinking out loud — instead of one big webinar, can we frame a 45m slot as 3 x 12m vignettes for different buyer personas? quick sketches below, want thoughts.

Jon (content): love that. shorter bits keep live demos tight. plus easier to recruit speakers.

Liz (demand): +1. we can route invites to persona buckets and measure conversion by vignette watch. does this change landing page copy?

Maya (mktg): yes — two landing CTA flows: 'prod infra' and 'platform ops' + generic 'get started'. Sam can we get the run-of-show stub for ops?

Sam (prod): dropping a rough RoS. can iterate in rehearsal.
```
00:00 - 03:00 - Welcome + framing (Maya)
03:00 - 15:00 - Vignette A: 'Cost-focused infra' demo (Speaker A)
15:00 - 27:00 - Vignette B: 'SLA & reliability patterns' (Speaker B)
27:00 - 39:00 - Vignette C: 'Private deployment & security' (Speaker C)
39:00 - 45:00 - Panel + live Qs + CTA (Maya + speakers)
```

Emily (events): FYI greenroom windows: speakers need to join 25m before. can we give each speaker a 15m rehearsal slot day-of?

Maya (mktg): yes. also want a short pre-record fallback clip per vignette in case demo flakes. 90s each.

Liz (demand): for routing — propose 3 invite tracks: "Cost Signals", "SRE + SLA", "Security & Compliance". we can A/B subject lines.

Jon (content): draft abstracts (very short):
- Vignette A: "Cut token spend without losing quality — batching, cache, and model selection patterns."
- Vignette B: "Hit latency SLAs at scale — routing, autoscale knobs, and graceful fallbacks."
- Vignette C: "Keep inference in your control — private deploys, KMS integration, audit trails."

Sam (prod): speaker heatmap idea: put primary demo owners for each vignette + a backup who's done the pre-record. reduces last-minute scrambles.

ops-bot: reminder: book-rooms required: greenroom-1 (10:30-11:30), staging (11:30-12:00) — calendar invites sent.

Emily (events): checklist I'm adding to the runbook: mic checks, network check (2x VPN test), pre-record fallback uploaded to s3, slide deck with 16:9 PNG fallback.

Maya (mktg): approvals needed: speaker bios & headshots by EOD Fri, webinar description copy by Mon, rehearsal windows scheduled. who owns speaker comms? @Jon

Jon (content): I'll own speaker comms. I'll ping folks to confirm tech needs and collect bios.

Liz (demand): tracking: set UTM per invite track + hidden field for persona. can ops add 3 custom UTM params?

Sam (prod): yep — we'll surface them in the webinar pixel. also adding a small demo toggle: if GPU quota low, switch A -> A-light (quantized) automatically.

Maya (mktg): perfect. one more ask: can we get 2 rehearsal run-throughs? full dress + dry run 48h prior. Emily can we block those?

Emily (events): blocked. full dress Thurs 10:00-11:00, dry run Tue 09:00-09:30. invites will follow. :white_check_mark:

Jon (content): I'll draft the short email copy and three subject lines per track. will post first draft here by tomorrow.

Maya (mktg): awesome. tiny ops request — add a cancel/fallback flow to the landing page so we can reschedule watchers to the recording if live fails.

Sam (prod): will add a redirect + fallback sign-up that points to the recording bucket and marks attendees as "fallback_viewers".

Liz (demand): reporting: post-event we want conversion by persona, and heatmap of which vignette drove the demo request. tagging the funnel owner @Liz.

Maya (mktg): thanks team. next steps: Jon (copy + speaker comms), Emily (rehearsal invites + runbook), Sam (RoS + fallback video hooks), Liz (invite segmentation + UTMs). check back here with flags. :rocket:

Jon (content): one flag — need confirmation on speaker B's demo access to a staging dataset. @Sam can you confirm permissions?

Sam (prod): confirmed, I'll provision a read-only staging key and share in greenroom doc.

Emily (events): final note — anyone who wants a speaker cue card template, ping me. I'll drop a Google doc.

Maya (mktg): closing the thread for now. will open rehearsal-specific threads later. thanks! :clap:
